summary: Immix Biopharma filed an 8-K disclosing the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 16,778,524 shares of common stock at $8.94 per share, with expected net proceeds of approximately $140.65 million. The offering is being conducted under an existing shelf registration statement with Morgan Stanley as underwriter. It is an ordinary equity capital raise, not a special situation. The offering is scheduled to close on May 22, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No strategic event, such as an acquisition, restructuring, or other special situation, is involved.
